newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish new car registrations up 43 pct. [CORRECTED 09:43 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swedish new car registrations up 43 pct. [CORRECTED 09:43 GMT]

text.p: New car registrations in Sweden rose 43 percent from 11,714 units, Statistics Sweden said on Monday. (Corrects that 43 percent rise is from, not to, 11,714 units)

"The number of new cars totalled 16,706 in January 1997 according to Statistics Sweden. This is an increase of 42.6 percent compared to January 1996 when 11,714 new cars were registered," Statistics Sweden said.
New lorry registrations rose 46.8 percent to 1,826 compared with 1,244 registrations in January 1996.
